memo: Bronze-path test on the 0.440 base, CPU kernel (GPU quota spent until 10-17). Base: canqiang/casmi26-e006-window-40-ice-fallback-true v1 (public LB 0.440, Apache-2.0); our best stack kept (fragment re-rank on blind molecules + neutral-loss evidence = e3fg05nl05c-1 0.434). On the CPU the base's ICEBERG runs 1.55 predictions/s, so its 5400 s budget scores only about a third of the ~26k candidates (GPU: all), and every CPU build so far ran a reduced E006. This build raises the base's ICE_BUDGET to 12600 s (about three quarters of the candidates; estimated total under 7.5 h of the 9 h limit), so our parts sit on a near-full E006. Hypothesis: the gap between our CPU builds (0.432-0.434) and the GPU base (0.440) is ICEBERG coverage; with it restored our stack reaches LB >= 0.441 (bronze). Also tells whether the 10-17 GPU build is needed for the same answer.
message: e3fg05nl05ib126c-1: E006 0.440 base (CPU, ICEBERG budget 12600 s) + our fragment re-rank + neutral-loss evidence. Hypothesis: LB >= 0.441
